transcript:
A It was an experiment because the students were randomly assigned to groups.

B Retrieval practice meant taking three 10-question short-answer quizzes on the passage without looking at it.

C The retrieval group did better on the test a week later, 78% compared with 64%.

D The researchers got informed consent.

E The study is generalizable because 120 students is a big sample.

F This supports the testing effect because the students who quizzed themselves scored 78% while the rereading group scored 64%, so practicing retrieval helped them remember more.
